title: Spiral Stitch: 40 mm ring with a 15 mm hole, defaults
description: PE-DESIGN 11.50's Spiral Stitch: one path from the start point on the outline, the outline offset a row (1 / density) inwards per turn to the middle (turns 0.5 mm apart on both axes of the rectangle), 4·2^n needle points a smooth turn, corners kept on a rectangle. With a hole PE-DESIGN sews the outline's spiral inwards to the middle of the band, about 30 short pieces there with a tie-in, lock and trim each (64 trims, a dark band of overlapping passes), then the hole's spiral; OpenStitch joins the two spirals with one travel, so the stitch count (1473 against 1952) is not compared: bounds and stitch lengths are. Measured 2026-10-30: the band pieces are 31 wedges about 5.5° wide every 11.25° at r 13.4–14.0 mm (397 needle points, each with a tie-in, a lock and a trim); OpenStitch does not copy them.

references.make: a 15 mm circle centred at (50,50) mm, then the 40 mm circle around it (30,30)-(70,70); Ctrl+A; Home > Modify Overlap > Hole sewing > Set hole sewing; then the inner 15 mm circle's region set to Not Sewn (Region): a 40 mm ring with a 15 mm unsewn hole, two objects; region Spiral Stitch, every attribute at its default. Design Settings Hoop Size 100 x 100 mm (multi-needle machine type); line Not Sewn (Line); colour 800 EMBROIDERY RED (PEC 5); nothing else in the design. Region sew attributes of both Concentric Circle Stitch and Spiral Stitch: only Density (default 2,0 line/mm), Run pitch (default 2,0 mm) and Start Point (two buttons, default the first); no direction, under sewing or pull compensation. Defaults reset between variants. Save As PES (default type, #PES0110). Status bar 39,30 x 39,70 mm, Stitches = 1952.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50's file: the spiral never runs more than 0.05 mm over the run pitch
